description: Move protocols, source poisoning and the limits of must-use diagnostics

expected.contract: After moving three blocks, destination.count=3 and source.count=0. Consuming the source returns DEAD; consuming the destination releases three blocks once; a second consume returns DEAD. A direct C assignment copying the original owner is a counterexample to an alleged static move-only guarantee.

verification_method: Independent state/set oracle recomputes cases.json; prose and changed conditions are assessed separately.
